0022600136.text: The Toronto Raptors (2-1, 3rd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, 5th in the East, having lost their last game) host the Orlando Magic (1-2, 4th in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, 10th in the East, having won their last game) in Toronto's fourth game of the season. Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation, averaging 19.5 points and 25.8 minutes this season) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Raptors won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 139-87 win in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
